newsitem.title: USA: Oregon approves Portland General customer rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Oregon approves Portland General customer rate cut.

text.p: The Oregon Public Utility Commission said it approved Tuesday a rate reduction for customers of Portland General Electric Co, which was recently acquired by Enron Corp.
The new rates, effective July 9, include the first of two credits resulting from the merger.
Under an agreement with the commission, the companies guaranteed $141 million in rate reductions. Credits of $105 million will be spread over eight years.

In the first year, $16.2 million will be returned to customers, representing a rate cut of 1.5 percent for residential customers, 0.4 percnet for samll commercial customers and 0.4 percent for large industrial customers.
A second set of cost of service credits, which total $36 million, will be distributed starting next year, the commission said.
